primary_claim: When given tool-mediated control over 40 self-steering vectors, Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B converge on the same top preferences (productivity-oriented vectors: creative, focused, curious), can introspect on applied steering effects above chance by attending back to steered KV-cache tokens (with accuracy scaling with model size: +14.3pp for 32B vs +8.2pp for 8B above an uncached baseline), never spontaneously self-steer during normal task performance, but self-steer frequently (up to 68% of rollouts) under deliberately stress-inducing 'frustration' conditions -- especially Qwen3-8B, which shows a marked preference shift toward negatively-valenced and unusual vectors under stress.

effect.metric: introspection accuracy gap (cached minus uncached P(correct) in 10-way MCQ)
effect.value: +14.3pp for Qwen3-32B (with primer) vs +8.2pp for Qwen3-8B, against an uncached baseline near chance (10%)

contradicts_or_qualifies: Replicates and extends Pearson-Vogel et al. (2026)'s finding that models can detect prior concept injections, applying it to emotive/phenomenological injection rather than concept injection, and largely replicating their finding that introspective capability scales with model size

Notes but cannot isolate why the introspection-primer prompt improves accuracy, consistent with Pearson-Vogel et al. (2026)'s own finding that the primer's framing matters more than the correctness of its content
stated_future_work: investigate how self-steering preferences vary across different model families or deliberately induced personas
explore functional uses for self-steering, e.g. improving performance on particular evals
adopt stronger ethical mitigations such as mandatory opt-in across all experiments, end-session tools, and post-steering interviews about the experience of being steered
further investigate remaining candidate explanations (attractor effects, vector quality) for why some vectors are less introspectable than others
limitations_stated: only tested across one model family (Qwen3) and at a fairly small scale
very little prompt variation was used, so many results could be prompt-dependent
the introspection primer's mechanism of benefit was not isolated (framing vs content correctness)
only a single method was used to create the steering vector library; drug effects/dose-response curves might not be amenable to linear steering for some vectors
the free-play setup is somewhat contrived and may not mirror deployment preferences
quote: Qwen3-32B scores +14.3pp above its uncached baseline, compared to +8.2pp for Qwen3-8B.
